source_evidence: You can choose when to annuitize (begin payment).
question: Misconception: A variable annuity always starts making payout payments automatically as soon as the accumulation phase ends.
answer: Not necessarily. You can choose when to begin payments, although a contract may automatically annuitize at a specified age. The accumulation phase is when you make purchase payments and your money is allowed to grow; the payout phase is when you receive payments.
